claims.statement: US Dec16 memorandum says land law promulgated June22; Korean Gazette dates Act 31 June21
US memorandum dates Assembly override June21; Korean constitutional history cites June14-15 resolution
ECA proposed eight economic stabilization steps in November 1949; proposals are not proof of implementation
November US report records proposed counterpart rates 500 won and 600 won per dollar, not actual settled rates
January US report observed rice collection, coal logistics and power constraints
December US memo says Rhee authorized 100 billion won for land implementation; Korean budget warrant not opened
December 30 US instruction sought Korean economic stabilization reports and action
October 1950 US Embassy described land reform as underway at invasion; percentages are preliminary estimates
October 1950 Embassy reproduced translated presidential land policy statement for northern areas
1950 FRUS editorial note corrects reference from telegram 249 to 245
